quests.name: Short on Maple Logs
quests.summary: The banker of Brackenholt has run out of maple logs.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 26 maple logs and nobody in Brackenholt has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Barber
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Brackenholt to the barber.
intro: This should have gone to the barber days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the general store keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Fishing Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the fishing shop keeper of Brackenholt and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the fishing shop keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The barber sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Brackenholt Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Brackenholt Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Brackenholt Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Spiders
quests.summary: The archery shop keeper wants the spider near Brackenholt thinned out.
intro: The spider beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 13 of them close to Brackenholt and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Bones
quests.summary: The magic shop keeper of Brackenholt has run out of bones.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 16 bones and nobody in Brackenholt has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the clothes shop keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Sword Shop Keeper

outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The food shop keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Supply Run to Sarnwick
quests.summary: Gather raw lobster for the banker, then carry a shipment to Sarnwick.
intro: I have an order from Sarnwick and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 21 raw lobster, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the banker in Brackenholt.
From Brackenholt? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Brackenholt and bring back mithril ore.
intro: The wilds around Brackenholt need a firm hand. Start with 13 ghost outside the walls, then 21 snake down in Brackenholt Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 21 mithril ore to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Brackenholt for the barber.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the banker, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The barber asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the fishing shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the banker.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: Sweeping the Brackenholt Sewers
quests.summary: Clear giant spider out of Brackenholt Sewers and tell the realtor.
intro: Brackenholt Sewers is crawling with giant spider, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 21 of them, then let the realtor know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Brackenholt owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Brackenholt Sewers is clearer than it was. 21 giant spider fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: The Brackenholt Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Brackenholt and Sarnwick.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Sarnwick. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 31 spider near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the banker underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the general store keeper in Brackenholt.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Sarnwick is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Brackenholt has not had news this good in years.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Brackenholt
quests.summary: Find what rules Brackenholt Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Rat King.
intro: Something rules Brackenholt Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the food shop keeper what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Brackenholt is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Rat King.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Rat King is dead. Brackenholt Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.

quests.name: The Fall of the Broodmother
quests.summary: March on Rootbound Hollow, break its creatures and bring down The Broodmother.
intro: Rootbound Hollow has stood against Brackenholt for too long. The Broodmother sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the realtor, fight your way through 31 giant bat and end The Broodmother.
Bring 21 raw salmon back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Rootbound Hollow?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Broodmother rules it now.
player: Word from Brackenholt: The Broodmother is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.
